title: Standardized SPME-GC-MS Protocol for the Detection of Volatile and Semi-Volatile Compounds in Human Serum
author: Lilia C. Soler-Jiménez

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Thaw serum samples on ice.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube, mix: o 100 µL of blood serum o 200 µL of HPLC-grade methanol

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Vortex for 30 seconds.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes to allow protein precipitation.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,500 rpm for 10 minutes.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Transfer the clear supernatant to a 0.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Store the supernatant at 4°C if not analyzed immediately (up to 24 hours).

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Precondition the DVB/CAR/PDMS fiber as per manufacturer instructions.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Introduce the DVB/CAR/PDMS SPME fiber directly into the serum supernatant.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Allow extraction to proceed for 30 minutes at room temperature.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Immediately transfer the fiber to the GC inlet for thermal desorption. Optional : For volatile-only profiling, perform headspace extraction at 40 °C.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Desorb the fiber in the GC injector at 270 °C for 5 min in splitless mode.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Run GC-MS with the specified temperature program.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Acquire mass spectra in full scan mode (m/z 50–650).

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Perform peak deconvolution.

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Identify compounds using the NIST library (Salek et al 2013).

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Normalize peak areas and calculate retention indices (Sun and Stremple 2003).

steps_raw.title: Procedure
steps_raw.instruction: Compare VOC profiles between Chagas-positive and negative groups.
Troubleshooting

steps_raw.title: Critical Notes
steps_raw.instruction: Perform all extractions in triplicate to assess reproducibility.

steps_raw.title: Critical Notes
steps_raw.instruction: Regularly clean the injector port and replace the septum to avoid carryover.

steps_raw.title: Critical Notes
steps_raw.instruction: Ensure fibers are properly conditioned before use.

steps_raw.title: Critical Notes
steps_raw.instruction: Store samples and extracts cold to avoid degradation.
